title: InterviewerExampleSchema
description: Schema for interviewer question generation, adaptive probing, and conversation orchestration training.

example_id.description: Unique identifier for the interviewer dialogue training example.

instruction.description: Directive for the interviewer agent (e.g., probe candidate regarding database indexing trade-offs).

context.description: Prior interview history or conversational transcript leading to this prompt.

candidate_context.description: Specific candidate profile, resume excerpt, or prior answer mention.

current_skill.description: Skill domain currently being tested (e.g. Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker).

expected_response.description: Exemplary interviewer spoken phrasing to deliver to the candidate.

expected_length.description: Target length of the interviewer verbal prompt.
